This allows Emacs to insert a matching closing parenthesis when the corresponding opening one is typed, ensuring balance. To enable this behavior, `skeleton-pair` must be set to a non-nil value [1] and, optionally, `skeleton-pair-on-word` can be set to ensure pairing occurs even when the following character is part of a word [1] . This mechanism ensures that pairs like parentheses are balanced automatically, making typing more efficient and less error-prone [2] . The feature is particularly helpful for users with non-QWERTY keyboards or those who frequently work with programming syntax [2]
